name: proj-mica-e2e
_comment: The E2E toolchain only. This module SHIPS as a directory - REDCap deploys the whole tree - so
nothing here may be a runtime dependency. Playwright is therefore a devDependency, for the same
reason PHPUnit lives in tools/composer.json rather than in require-dev: the split is structural,
not a flag somebody has to remember.
node_modules is gitignored and npm is never run in production, so this file's only job is to make
`node e2e/*.js` reproducible instead of depending on whatever happened to be installed. The
browser binaries are NOT in here - run `npx playwright install chromium` once if the cache is cold.
The SPAs have their own package.json files (mica-review/, mica-chatbot/) and are unaffected.

scripts.e2e:install: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
